attempts.text:
**The window starts on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `dcd`, `asma` and `yegH`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 11% of calls. The model names 85 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `yegH`, 85%, where it hesitates 0.51 bits.

**Then a long fork and variable stretch**, columns 3 to 35, in a region of plasticity in 46 to 97% of calls. The `wca` genes and their neighbours, [[colanic acid biosynthesis]], are variable columns 3 to 23, carried by 54 to 83% of chromosomes; column 24 is a fork, `galF` persistent at 90%. The model names 29 to 93% here, fewest at column 3, 29%, and hesitates most at column 25, `rfbB`, 1.97 bits, in a region of plasticity in 97% of calls.

**A spine follows at `gndA` and `ugd`**, columns 36 to 37, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 25 to 35% of calls, named 76 to 83%. Then the `his` genes, columns 39 to 47, [[histidine biosynthesis]], persistent, named 84 to 94%, and the toxin-antitoxin pair `yefM` to `yoeB`, variable columns 48 to 49, named 82 to 83%.

**The last stretch is fork and variable**, columns 57 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 34 to 71% of calls, named 74 to 86%, most hesitant at column 61, 1.32 bits. Branches there carry the `pdu` genes, [[propanediol utilization]], 11 families through columns 64 to 74 at 14 to 15%, and 3 through columns 76 to 78 at 11 to 14%. The window ends at column 79, a putative zinc ribbon protein, in 16% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 78% of genes**, 0.79 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.08 against 0.37 bits, and names fewer genes, 68% against 92%.

label: dcd
facts:
WINDOW: the dcd window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor dcd, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,653 to 1,732 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying dcd once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 78% of genes, 0.79 bits on average (perplexity 2.8 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 16,120 calls, named 95%, 0.33 bits; shell 23,142 calls, named 77%, 0.83 bits; cloud 3,938 calls, named 14%, 2.40 bits. Outside an RGP 18,016 calls, named 92%, 0.37 bits; inside an RGP 25,184 calls, named 68%, 1.08 bits. Columns: 18 spine, 22 fork, 40 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.08 against 0.37 bits) and names fewer genes (68% against 92%); 25,184 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 25 (rfbB) 1.97 bits, RGP 97%; column 26 (rfbD) 1.86 bits, RGP 95%; column 29 (fbaB) 1.68 bits, RGP 86%. The 51 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 73%, 0.91 bits on average; the other 29 columns: named 86%, 0.57 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 3-35 (fork and variable columns), RGP 46-97%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0.2-11%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-11%. Genes: dcd, asmA, yegH "TerC family protein". named 85-99.8% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2 (yegH), named 85%, 0.51 bits.
2. columns 3-35 (33 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 46-97%. named 29-93% (mean 70%), fewest named at column 3, named 29%; most hesitant at column 25, 1.97 bits.
   columns 3-23 variable, share 54-83%, all S: "hypothetical protein" 54%, wza 82%, wzb 83%, wzc 82%, wcaA 82%, wcaB "colanic acid biosynthesis acetyltra…" 82%, wcaC 82%, wcaD 81%, wcaE 81%, wcaF 81%, gmd 82%, fcl 81%, gmm 81%, wcaI 81%, cpsB 80%, cpsG "putative phosphomannomutase" 81%, wcaJ 81%, wzxC 82%, wcaK 81%, wcaL "colanic acid biosynthesis glycosylt…" 81%, wcaM 78%
   24 fork: galF P 90%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 31%, gne S 24%
   columns 25-35 variable, share 8-39%, 7 P, 4 S: rfbB 39%, rfbD 32%, rfbA "sugar phosphate nucleotidyltransfer…" 33%, rfbC 19%, fbaB 8%, yegT "MFS transporter" 8%, yegU "ADP-ribosylglycohydrolase family pr…" 8%, yegV "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase" 8%, yegW "UTRA domain-containing protein" 8%, yegX "GH25 family lysozyme" 8%, thiD 8%
3. columns 36-37 (2 columns) spine: share 90-92%, all P, RGP 25-35%. Genes: gndA, ugd. named 76-83% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 36 (gndA), named 76%, 0.69 bits.
4. column 38 variable: RGP 17%. named 85%; 0.48 bits.
   38: wzzB S 76%
5. columns 39-47 (9 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 8-14%. Genes: hisIE, hisF "imidazole glycerol phosphate syntha…", hisA, hisH, hisB, hisC, hisD, hisG, hisL. named 84-94% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 47 (hisL), named 84%, 0.47 bits.
6. columns 48-49 (2 columns) variable: RGP 12-13%. named 82-83% (mean 82%), fewest named at column 48, named 82%; most hesitant at column 49, 0.55 bits.
   48: yefM S 63% "YoeB-YefM toxin-antitoxin system an…"
   49: yoeB S 63% "type II toxin-antitoxin system mRNA…"
7. column 50 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 16%. Genes: yeeZ "NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase…". named 82%; 0.52 bits.
8. column 51 variable: RGP 17%. named 88%; 0.55 bits.
   51: yeeY P 90% "LysR family transcriptional regulat…"
9. columns 52-53 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 19-20%. Genes: yoeI "membrane protein YoeI", plaP. named 88-89% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 53 (plaP), named 88%, 0.57 bits.
10. columns 54-55 (2 columns) variable: RGP 22-24%. named 89-90% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 54, named 89%; most hesitant at column 55, 0.77 bits.
   54: tsuA S 74%
   55: tsuB S 77% "thiosulfate utilization sulfurtrans…"
11. column 56 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 29%. Genes: sbcB. named 87%; 0.79 bits.
